title: The LORD Sent Me to Anoint You
text: The LORD sent me to anoint you king over His people Israel.

title: Listen to the Words of the LORD
text: Now therefore, listen to the words of the LORD.

title: What the Amalekites Did
text: I witnessed what the Amalekites did to the Israelites when they opposed them on their way up from Egypt.

title: Devote to Destruction
text: Now go and attack the Amalekites and devote to destruction all that belongs to them.

title: Numbered at Telaim
text: So Saul summoned the troops and numbered them at Telaim …

title: 200,000 Foot Soldiers
text: … 200,000 foot soldiers and 10,000 men of Judah.

title: The Kenites Moved Away
text: So the Kenites moved away from the Amalekites.

title: You Showed Kindness
text: Since you showed kindness to all the Israelites when they came up out of Egypt, go on and get away from the Amalekites.

title: From Havilah to Shur
text: Then Saul struck down the Amalekites all the way from Havilah to Shur, which is east of Egypt.

title: Agag Alive
text: He captured Agag king of Amalek alive …

title: The Best of the Sheep and Cattle
text: Saul and his troops spared Agag, along with the best of the sheep and cattle, the fat calves and lambs, and the best of everything else.

title: Unwilling to Devote Them
text: They were unwilling to devote them to destruction …

title: Despised and Worthless
text: … but they devoted to destruction all that was despised and worthless.

title: The Word of the LORD Came
text: Then the word of the LORD came to Samuel, saying,

title: I Regret
text: I regret that I have made Saul king …

title: He Has Turned Away
text: … for he has turned away from following Me and has not carried out My instructions.

title: Samuel Cried Out All That Night
text: And Samuel was distressed and cried out to the LORD all that night.

title: Saul Went to Carmel
text: Saul has gone to Carmel, and behold, he has set up a monument for himself …

title: A Monument for Himself
text: … he has set up a monument for himself and has turned and gone down to Gilgal.

title: Down to Gilgal
text: … and has turned and gone down to Gilgal.

title: I Have Carried Out the LORD’s Instructions
text: May the LORD bless you. I have carried out the LORD’s instructions.

title: What Is This Bleating?
text: Then what is this bleating of sheep and lowing of cattle that I hear?

title: They Spared the Best
text: The troops brought them from the Amalekites; they spared the best sheep and cattle to sacrifice to the LORD your God …

title: What the LORD Said Last Night
text: Stop! | Let me tell you what the LORD said to me last night.

title: Small in Your Own Eyes
text: Although you were once small in your own eyes, have you not become the head of the tribes of Israel?

title: Why Did You Rush upon the Plunder?
text: So why did you not obey the LORD? Why did you rush upon the plunder and do evil in the sight of the LORD?

title: But I Did Obey
text: But I did obey the LORD …

title: Obedience Is Better than Sacrifice
text: Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams.

title: Attentiveness
text: … and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams.

title: Rebellion
text: For rebellion is like the sin of divination, and arrogance is like the wickedness of idolatry.

title: Rejected as King
text: Because you have rejected the word of the LORD, He has rejected you as king.

title: I Feared the People
text: I have sinned; I have transgressed the LORD’s commandment and your instructions, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.

title: The Hem of His Robe
text: As Samuel turned to go, Saul grabbed the hem of his robe, and it tore.

title: The Kingdom Torn from You
text: The LORD has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to your neighbor who is better than you.

title: The Glory of Israel
text: Moreover, the Glory of Israel does not lie or change His mind, for He is not a man, that He should change His mind.

title: Honor Me before the Elders
text: Please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel.

title: Mercy, Not Sacrifice
text: But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’

title: Saul Worshiped
text: So Samuel went back with Saul, and Saul worshiped the LORD.

title: Never Again
text: And to the day of his death, Samuel never again visited Saul.

title: Samuel Mourned for Saul
text: Samuel mourned for Saul, and the LORD regretted that He had made Saul king over Israel.

title: How Long Will You Mourn?
text: How long are you going to mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him as king over Israel?

title: To Jesse of Bethlehem
text: I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem, for I have selected from his sons a king for Myself.

title: Kindness Remembered
text: Since you showed kindness to all the Israelites when they came up out of Egypt …

title: The Biggest Army
text: So Saul summoned the troops and numbered them at Telaim—200,000 foot soldiers and 10,000 men of Judah.

title: A Splendid Sacrifice
text: They were unwilling to devote them to destruction …

title: The King of Amalek
text: He captured Agag king of Amalek alive …

title: Distressed
text: And Samuel was distressed and cried out to the LORD all that night.
